letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. I smile at the thought of our wedding day lingering in the air, a sweet whisper of February magic that still feels brand‑new. You are my compass, my laughter, the warmest hug after a long flight. I love you more with each passing day, and I can’t wait for all the adventures still waiting for us.
poem:
In desert dunes or city’s glow,  
Your love’s the rhythm I always know.  
Rain‑kissed streets or golden sand,  
Together, forever—hand in hand.
